title: cleisostoma krabiense
intro: Cleisostoma krabiense, commonly known as the Krabi Cleisostoma, is a species of orchid that belongs to the genus Cleisostoma. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and promoting relaxation due to its therapeutic actions. The bioactive constituents of Cleisostoma krabiense include flavonoids and alkaloids, which are believed to be responsible for its medicinal properties. However, more research is needed to fully understand the extent of its health benefits and therapeutic actions.
